translations.web: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.
translations.bsb: See how Your enemies rage, how Your foes have reared their heads.
translations.kjv: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
translations.asv: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult; And they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
